commands.label: example-skill
commands.command: ls -R skills/yf-markdown-lint | head -40; echo ---; cat skills/yf-markdown-lint/SKILL.md | head -80

commands.label: spec-grep
commands.command: ls; grep -n 'REQ-' SPEC.md | head -20; grep -n -i 'amendment' SPEC.md | head -10; wc -l SPEC.md

commands.label: skill-registration
commands.command: grep -rn 'yf-markdown-lint' --include='*.rs' --include='*.toml' --include='*.md' --include='*.json' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^./skills/yf-markdown-lint' | grep -v docs/plans | grep -v docs/research | head -30
